primary_failures: M7 A uses Seven Days UI
M7 B uses Seven Days UI

reason: The manual R9 instruction invoked test_m7_playable_networked_processes.gd directly from the ordinary Windows shell.

The repository-owned RUN_M7_PLAYABLE_NETWORKED_PLAYGROUND_TESTS.ps1 establishes an isolated HOME, USERPROFILE, APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, XDG_DATA_HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_CACHE_HOME for every test process.
The repository-owned runner also performs a clean isolated editor import before runtime tests.
The manual instruction omitted both the isolated parent profile and the editor-import prerequisite.

The observed failure is entirely on UI/profile/shutdown predicates while the repaired M7 item acceptance target is 7/2 and player convergence checksums match, so the attempt does not demonstrate failure of the R9 camera-basis repair.
corrected_validation_preconditions: Fresh isolated parent test profile for each M7 attempt including USERPROFILE.
Clean isolated editor import before the first M7 attempt.
